in_hindi.name: दिवाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: दिवाली एक हिंदू तिथि है जो अश्विन शुक्लपक्ष के अमावास्या रात्रि के दिन है।

in_tamil.name: திப்பத்தி
in_tamil.long_meaning: திங்கள் மாதம் (கார்த்திகை) மேல் ஆமாவாசியா (ஆமாவாசியாழ்) திதி மாதிரியான இன்ப்போஷன் நாள்

in_telugu.name: దీపావళి
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఆమావాశ్యా (ఆమావాశ్యాధీశ) రోజు, ఇహోష మేఘాదీప్పేశ మీయేదు మేఘాదీప్పేశ మూదోదేశయే హిందుయ మీపడిపోయిదే మీపోయేదే మీదేపోయేదే దినే

in_marathi.name: Deepavali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Row of Lamps
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepavali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deepavali is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Deepa’ which means ‘lamp’ and ‘vali’ which means ‘a row’. The festival symbolizes the victory of light over darkness, and is celebrated by lighting oil lamps, decorating homes with colorful rangolis, and enjoying delicious sweets.

in_bengali.name: Deepavali
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Row of Lamps
in_bengali.long_meaning: Deepavali একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Deepavali is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Deepa’ which means ‘lamp’ and ‘vali’ which means ‘a row’. The festival symbolizes the victory of light over darkness, and is celebrated by lighting oil lamps, decorating homes with colorful rangolis, and enjoying delicious sweets.
